items.name: DAB+ Block 6A — 181.936 MHz (Gharghur 10 kW + Zebbug, Gozo)
items.description: Malta's DAB+ ensemble 6A (operator: Digi B Network): BBC World Service (C001), Rai Radio 1/2/3 (C002–C004), RTL 102.5, All 80s, 103, Net FM (C008, 104 k), Campus 103.7, ONE Radio, Radju Marija, Radio Deejay, All Rock, Bay 89.7, Vibe, All Groove, Bay Easy, VOA (no audio at observation), Radju Malta 1 (C01C). Carries the international sports feeds.
items.notes: Service table from wohnort.org receiver observations dated 13 Jan 2026 — the strongest available carriage evidence; re-scan 6A on arrival (multiplexes change). Operator's own catalogue (dab.com.mt/channels, re-read 9 Oct 2026) lists the same services (Rai 1/2/3, BBC World Service, VOA, DeeJay, RTL 102.5, Campus, Radju Malta, All Groove, Vibe, All Rock, Bay Easy, Radio 105, NET FM, ONE, 103, Radju Marija, All 80s, …) and does NOT list a talkSPORT/“Sports Channel” entry.

items.name: Sports Channel (talkSPORT) on DAB+ 6C
items.description: The UK's main sports-talk station, relayed on 6C labelled “Sports Channel” (C02F, 32 kbit/s). talkSPORT holds the Premier League's UK live audio rights and a separate international audio package — the strongest full-match EPL candidate in Malta.
items.notes: Identification rests on three independent sources (radioinmalta directory — re-read 9 Oct 2026: “Talk Sport — DAB+ (Labelled as Sports Channel)”; RadioBlog.eu on-island listening report Oct 2023; Wikipedia talkSPORT infobox “DAB+: 6C (Malta)”). The multiplex operator's own catalogue (dab.com.mt, re-read 9 Oct 2026) does NOT list it. No date-specific Malta feed is published for 17–19 Oct — which games it calls is announced around match day. Tune in Sat 17 Oct 13:25 Malta (Everton–Chelsea, talkSPORT's UK slot) to test the feed.

items.name: Radio Sportiva (Mediahit) on DAB+ 6C
items.description: Italy's private all-sports talk station (Mediahit group — not a Rai channel). Discusses Serie A but does not hold Rai's live commentary rights; for Serie A the lead is Rai Radio 1's Tutto il calcio minuto per minuto on 6A.
items.notes: Operator catalogue (re-read 9 Oct 2026) + Jan 2026 observation. Earlier mislabelling as a Rai channel corrected 23 Sep 2026.

items.name: Rai Radio 1 on DAB+ 6A (Serie A — Tutto il calcio minuto per minuto)
items.hours: Sabato Sport Sat 14:00–23:30 · Domenica Sport Sun 12:25–23:30 (pattern)
items.description: Italy's public radio carries the weekend Serie A strands with live commentary of the evening matches (Tutto il calcio minuto per minuto from 14:50). For MD7 (16–19 Oct): Sat 17 — Venezia–Napoli 15:00, Bologna–Inter 18:00, Roma–Genoa 20:45; Sun 18 — Udinese–Lecce 12:30, Fiorentina–Como 15:00, Milan–Atalanta 18:00, Juventus–Lazio 20:45; Mon 19 — Monza–Cagliari 18:30, Parma–Torino 20:45. Italian only.
items.notes: Programme page (official) + slot pattern from the published palinsesto as reproduced by a fan blog (flag). Rai's per-match commentator assignments for 16–19 Oct are published the week of the games — not in advance.

items.name: BBC Sportsworld slots — Sat 17 Oct 15:06 & Sun 18 Oct 16:06 Malta (official BBC schedule)
items.area: Malta (BBC World Service on DAB+ 6A, C001)
items.hours: Sat 17 Oct from 15:06 Malta (13:06 GMT) · Sun 18 Oct from 16:06 Malta (14:06 GMT)
items.description: BBC World Service's weekend live-sport programme — carries live Premier League commentary internationally. The BBC's own programme page lists episodes on Sat 17 Oct and Sun 18 Oct 2026 (re-read 9 Oct 2026: both still listed; the page renders viewer-local time — 09:06/10:06 in a UTC−4 view = 13:06/14:06 GMT = 15:06/16:06 Malta). Covers the Saturday 16:00-Malta kick-offs (Brentford–Liverpool, Fulham–Hull, Man City–Ipswich) and Forest–Arsenal (Sun 17:30 Malta).
items.notes: BBC programme page re-read 9 Oct 2026 — Sat 17 Oct and Sun 18 Oct episodes confirmed in the upcoming list (third read; unchanged since 24 Sep 2026). Which match gets full commentary is the BBC's weekly editorial pick — check the page on the Friday. BBC 5 Live is NOT on Malta's multiplex; Sportsworld is the World Service's own output so it does not depend on 5 Live. Campus FM 103.7 relays BBC World Service at times (relay of these slots unconfirmed).

items.name: EPL Matchweek 7 — Sat 17 / Sun 18 / Mon 19 Oct 2026 (official)
items.hours: Sat 17: 13:30 Everton–Chelsea (TNT) · 16:00 Brentford–Liverpool · 16:00 Fulham–Hull · 16:00 Man City–Ipswich · 18:30 Newcastle–Villa (Sky) · Sun 18: 15:00 Bournemouth–Sunderland (Sky) · 15:00 Brighton–Palace (Sky) · 15:00 Leeds–Man Utd (Sky) · 17:30 Forest–Arsenal (Sky) · Mon 19: 21:00 Spurs–Coventry (Sky)
items.description: The full in-window Premier League matchweek (10 matches). UK radio audio split (2025/26–2028/29 packages): talkSPORT holds Sat 12:30, Sat 19:30/20:00, Fri 19:30/20:00, Sun 12:00, Mon 20:00; BBC holds Sat 15:00 (two picks), Sat 17:30, Sun 14:00, Sun 15:30/16:30. MW7 has THREE Saturday-15:00 games but the BBC package covers only two — one gets no UK radio commentary.
items.notes: Official PL fixtures release (19 Jun 2026) + October/November amendments notice (17 Aug 2026) — re-verified 9 Oct 2026 against the official pages, The Guardian fixtures and OneFootball (all agree; MW7 = 17–19 Oct). Mon 19 Oct is your DEPARTURE day — Spurs–Coventry 21:00 Malta likely falls in transit.

items.name: Kalshi trading from Malta — permitted under Kalshi's own rules (help article + Member Agreement)
items.description: Kalshi's official help article (“Can I trade on Kalshi from outside the United States?”, updated 20 Mar 2026) says yes while travelling abroad, provided access is consistent with the Member Agreement's geographic requirements; the Agreement (§VI, v9.20.2026) bars trading while located in a Restricted Jurisdiction — Malta is NOT on the list (Italy, France, UK, Ireland, Switzerland, Belgium, Portugal, Poland, Hungary and ~50 others ARE — do not trade during such layovers; Germany/Netherlands/Denmark/Austria are not listed).
items.notes: Help article + Member Agreement (carried from 24 Sep 2026 verification). Kalshi may amend the list unilaterally and keeps sole discretion to block access — screenshot both before flying. Not betting advice.
